name: Typography
description: Long-form text styles on one class: headings, lists, quotes, inline and block code, keys, tables, figures, definition lists and disclosures get a steady vertical rhythm and a capped reading measure, in 3 sizes. Components placed inside keep their own look, and mv-not-prose opts any subtree out.

builder.summary: Clean styling for articles, docs and blog posts

quickstart:
Release notes

What changed in version 4.2.

Plain HTML from your CMS or Markdown renderer, styled as it is.
useWhen: Rendered Markdown or CMS HTML (blog posts, docs, changelogs) must read well without adding a class to every element
Legal pages, help articles or release notes need consistent headings, lists and tables at a comfortable line length
A sidebar or help panel shows rich text in a smaller size with the same rhythm as the main article

avoidWhen.when: The text is a UI label, card body or short marketing line rather than a flowing document
A code sample needs a file name, line numbers, a copy button or highlighted lines
Tabular data must be sorted, filtered or scanned with row hover and a sticky header

classes.name: mv-prose
classes.description: Container, on <article>, <main> or <div>. Styles its native descendants: h1 to h6, p, a, strong, em, small, mark, abbr, del, ins, sub, sup, ul/ol (nested), blockquote, cite, code, samp, pre, kbd, hr, table, figure, img, video, iframe, dl, details.

classes.name: mv-prose-lead
classes.description: Lead paragraph (standfirst) under the title: larger and muted.

classes.name: mv-not-prose
classes.description: Escape hatch: the element and its whole subtree keep the host styles, untouched by mv-prose.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: On .mv-prose: 14 / 16 / 18 px body text. Every margin is in em, so the rhythm scales with it.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: On th or td: cell alignment (numbers).

cssVars.name: --mv-prose-measure
cssVars.description: Maximum line length of the container. Use none to fill the parent.

cssVars.name: --mv-prose-headings
cssVars.description: Headings, strong text, table headers and code color.

cssVars.name: --mv-prose-muted
cssVars.description: List markers, captions and figure captions.

cssVars.name: --mv-prose-rule
cssVars.description: Rules, h2 underline, table rows, pre and details borders.

cssVars.name: --mv-prose-radius
cssVars.description: Radius of pre, images, videos and details.

cssVars.name: --mv-prose-scroll-margin
cssVars.description: Space kept above a heading reached by an anchor link (sticky headers).

a11y: Pure CSS on native elements: the document outline, lists, tables and disclosures keep their semantics. Colors come from the tokens (body text and captions at 4.5:1 or more in both themes), links stay underlined, and links, summary, a focusable pre and a focusable table wrapper get a visible focus ring. Give a long <pre> tabindex="0", and wrap a wide table in a plain <div role="region" aria-label="…" tabindex="0"> so keyboard users can scroll it sideways. In forced colors, inline code keeps an outline, keys keep their border and <mark> uses the system Mark colors. No animation. The scoping relies on CSS @scope (all current engines); older browsers show the plain host styles.
